unani.note: Akhrot is textbook garam — winter food.

histamine.note: SIGHI rates it 3 — the highest-rated nut, and well above the others.

nutrition.highlight: the only common nut with plant omega-3

effects.note: A 2025 randomized trial had 76 young adults eat 40g of walnuts nightly for 8 weeks and found higher melatonin breakdown products in their urine alongside shorter time to fall asleep and better sleep efficiency — one of the larger trials behind any food-level sleep claim here. A possible effect, not a promise — response to it varies from person to person.
